text:
maya.ram: Quick flag  onboarding 'tao-v2-q8' shows bracket mirroring errors when Arabic/Hebrew text contains embedded Japanese/Chinese segments. BLEU dropped for ar-IL and he-IL samples.
liang.wu: can you paste a minimal repro?
maya.ram: yes. input (ar): "قالت الشركة (東京) أن المبيعات بلغت ٢,٥٠٠ دولار."  fp16 -> "قالت الشركة (東京) أن المبيعات بلغت 2,500 دولار."  q8 -> "قالت الشركة )東京( أن المبيعات بلغت 2,500 دولار."  (parentheses got flipped)
omar.ahmed: that's the classic bidi mirror bug in the detokenizer. But strange it's only on q8.
jana.eval: ran token diffs. fp16 tokens: ["قالت", "الشركة", " ", "(", "東京", ")", " ", "أن", "المبيعات", "بلغت", " 2,500", " دولار", "."] q8 tokens: ["قالت", "الشركة", " ", ")東京(", " ", "أن", "المبيعات", "بلغت", " 2,500", " دولار."]
liang.wu: wtf. tokenizer artifact sha same?
maya.ram: yes same. suspect decode ordering or logits noise causing the tokenizer to produce a single token for the parenthesis+ja span in q8. Also the detok mirror routine triggers when span type == "paired_punct" and we lost the boundary.
ci-bot: nightly-eval run 4201234700: BLEU_fp16(ar-IL)=31.2 BLEU_q8(ar-IL)=24.1 BLEU_fp16(he-IL)=29.8 BLEU_q8(he-IL)=23.5 mean_len_fp16=20.1 mean_len_q8=19.4
omar.ahmed: any change in kernel selection?
liang.wu: yes log shows aten_mm_small_int8_v3 used instead of aten_mm_fp16_v1. Also see fuse_pass "paren_span_fuse" applied in int8 path (odd).
jana.eval: I tried beam_size=5 vs greedy. beam decode reduces mirror flips by ~50% (BLEU_q8->26.0) so search helps but doesn't fully fix.
maya.ram: I also toggled "bidi-detok-v2" flag in runtime. With v1 detok q8 BLEU=26.4, with v2 BLEU=24.1. Means v2 is stricter about pairing and maybe assumes token boundaries.
liang.wu: action list: (1) run tokenizer-only pass on the same text to confirm tokenizer binary deterministic; (2) dump token ids and byte offsets for the fused span; (3) add small synthetic set mixing RTL+CJK punctuation to eval suite; (4) revert or gate the paren_span_fuse in int8 path.
maya.ram: I'll own (3) and open a PR to add 120 synthetic cases (arabic/hebrew with ja/zh and numerals).
omar.ahmed: I'll reproduce locally and try disabling fuse_pass; also compare logits for boundary tokens to see rounding effects.
jana.eval: plugging the new suite into regression; will set alert if mirrored paired punct errors > 1% across locales.
liang.wu: quick workaround: in detok, prefer canonical mirror lookup based on Unicode Bidi_Class rather than relying on token spans. Might reduce false flips. But it's a patch, need tests.
ci-bot: created issue REDWOOD-ML-1311 referencing this thread and attached failing examples.
maya.ram: thanks all. keeping thread here. update when local repro done. :eyes:
